review_scope: Static narrow review of the fixed capacity-model first-passage point-RUL diagnostic. No checkpoint was opened, no deserialization/model construction/prediction/fit was performed, no raw data were read, and no lock/shared state was changed.

comparison_and_claims.frozen_gate: 0 noncross/invalid; at least 5% case-equal Time-MAE reduction; paired-cell bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0; at least 7/10 cells improve; severe-over-100 increase <= 0.01

nonblocking_audit_note.finding: Resolved in the reviewed runner revision: load attempts start at zero and increment immediately before the sole pickle.load attempt; failure tickets record that count and invocation_consumed=true.
nonblocking_audit_note.impact: Pre-load failures now report zero load attempts, while a failed open/deserialization attempt reports one. Exclusive invocation claim still prevents rerun.
nonblocking_audit_note.verification_scope: Only the three-line accounting delta and exact runner hash were rechecked; the prior static review findings remain bound to unchanged protocol and cohort hashes.

limitations: This is a generated-path point-RUL diagnostic on the same 10 exposed calibration cells, not independent confirmation.
Piecewise-linear 20-cycle synthetic future slope and repeated model extrapolation are assumptions that must be reported.
The age-support marker only indicates when model input age exceeds the fit-age bound; full covariate/joint support is not established.
No uncertainty or conditional distribution is implemented.
Capacity forecast capability does not establish dynamic-RUL improvement; instant and cumulative residual RUL corrections remain NO_GO per task context.

followup_hash_review.scope: Only failure load-attempt accounting delta; no checkpoint/model/data was opened.
